Notes from a seed swap

Last Saturday the library hosted a seed swap. We labelled each envelope with the crop, collection year, and the name of the person who brought it. Volunteers set aside a table for seedlings that needed transport home.

By midday we had more bean varieties than we could plant in one season. We decided to keep a second ledger in the garden shed to record which plants flower first and which pods survive the first cold night.

Save seeds only from healthy plants.
